scope: Physical Fortnite venues, subspaces and verified onsite location metadata relevant to France and Europe

principles.stable_venue_id: A venue_id is immutable across events; renames become aliases/history rather than a new venue when the physical venue is the same.
principles.address_precision: Never invent street, postal code, entrance or GEO. Store the most precise officially verified level only.
principles.geo_guard: GEO requires a direct venue/organizer source or another authoritative geocoding source explicitly recorded in geo_source.
principles.city_only_is_valid: CITY precision is valid when the organizer has announced only the city; do not upgrade it from third-party speculation.
principles.subspace_guard: Hall, stand, zone, stage, gate and entrance IDs exist only after a direct organizer/venue source identifies them. Never infer a hall from a convention floor plan unless it is explicitly tied to Fortnite.
principles.entrance_is_event_scoped_by_default: A special gate/entrance belongs to event access data unless the venue permanently identifies it.
principles.accessibility_unknown_by_default: PMR/accessibility, companion access, lifts, accessible entrances and seating remain UNKNOWN until a venue/organizer publishes them for the applicable event/venue scope.
principles.transport_is_advisory_not_canonical: Transport/parking details may be stored when officially published but never change the canonical venue identity or location precision.
principles.timezone_is_operational: Venue timezone is stored as an IANA timezone for session normalization; it is operational metadata, not proof of an event start time.
